46849-animal-life-of-the-british-isles.title: Of Wayside And Woodland
46849-animal-life-of-the-british-isles.creator: Edward Step, F.L.S.
46849-animal-life-of-the-british-isles.description: A book by Edward Step, F.L.S.. Although we have to regret the absence from our list of the Beaver and the Wild Boar, the Ure-ox and the Short-horned Wild Ox, the Brown Bear and the savage Wolf, there are still sufficient of our vertebrates left to give a zest to the observations of the rambler in the woodlands, over the mountains and along the quiet waysides and streams of our country.

arxiv-2012-14617.title: An Efficient Generation Method based on Dynamic Curvature of the Reference Curve for Robust Trajectory Planning
arxiv-2012-14617.creator: Yuchen Sun, Dongchun Ren, Shiqi Lian, Mingyu Fan, and Xiangyi Teng
arxiv-2012-14617.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Yuchen Sun, Dongchun Ren, Shiqi Lian, Mingyu Fan, and Xiangyi Teng. Trajectory planning is a fundamental task on various autonomous driving platforms, such as social robotics and self-driving cars. Many trajectory planning algorithms use a reference curve based Frenet frame with time to reduce the planning dimension. However, there is a common implicit assumption in classic trajectory planning approaches, which is that the generated trajectory should follow the reference curve continuously.

arxiv-2104-09570.title: Extracting Temporal Event Relation with Syntax-guided Graph Transformer
arxiv-2104-09570.creator: Shuaicheng Zhang, Qiang Ning, Lifu Huang
arxiv-2104-09570.description: Abstract Extracting temporal relations (e.g., before, after, and simultaneous) among events is crucial to natural language understanding. One of the key challenges of this problem is that when the events of interest are far away in text, the context in-between often becomes complicated, making it challenging to resolve the temporal relationship between them.

arxiv-2109-11534.title: UUITP–43/21 ℙ 1 \mathbb{P}^{1} -fibrations in F-theory and String Dualities
arxiv-2109-11534.creator: Lara B. Anderson, James Gray, Mohsen Karkheiran, Paul-Konstantin Oehlmann, Nikhil Raghuram
arxiv-2109-11534.description: Abstract In this work we study F-theory compactifications on elliptically fibered Calabi-Yau n n -folds which have ℙ 1 \mathbb{P}^{1} -fibered base manifolds. Such geometries, which we study in both 4- and 6-dimensions, are both ubiquitous within the set of Calabi-Yau manifolds and play a crucial role in heterotic/F-theory duality.

arxiv-2212-06160.title: Probing the muon ( g − 2 ) (g-2) anomaly at the LHC in final states with two muons and two taus
arxiv-2212-06160.creator: Yoav Afik, P. S. Bhupal Dev, Amarjit Soni, Fang Xu
arxiv-2212-06160.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Yoav Afik, P. S. Bhupal Dev, Amarjit Soni, Fang Xu. The longstanding muon ( g − 2 ) (g-2) anomaly, as well as some hints of lepton flavor universality violation in B B -meson decays, could be signaling new physics beyond the Standard Model (SM). A minimal R R -parity-violating supersymmetric framework with light third-generation sfermions (dubbed as ‘RPV3’) provides a compelling solution to these flavor anomalies, while simultaneously addressing other pressing issues of the SM.

arxiv-2402-15886.title: Extension of Bressoud’s generalization of Borwein’s conjecture and some exact results
arxiv-2402-15886.creator: Alexander Berkovich, Aritram Dhar
arxiv-2402-15886.description: Abstract . In this paper, we conjecture an extension to Bressoud’s 1996 generalization of Borwein’s famous 1990 conjecture. We then state a few infinite hierarchies of non-negative q q -series identities which are interesting examples of our proposed conjecture and Bressoud’s generalized conjecture.

arxiv-2407-10552.creator: M. A. Guerrero, R. Montez Jr, R. Ortiz, J. A. Toalá, J. H. Kastner
arxiv-2407-10552.description: Abstract Context. Asymptotic giant branch (AGB) stars are not expected to be X-ray-emitters, yet a small fraction of them, the so-called X-AGBs, show X-ray emission that can be attributed to coronal activity of a companion or accretion onto one. Aims.

arxiv-2501-18656.creator: Hongying Lin, Bo Zhou
arxiv-2501-18656.description: Abstract Let m m be a positive integer. Brualdi and Hoffman proposed the problem to determine the (connected) graphs with maximum spectral radius in a given graph class and they posed a conjecture for the class of graphs with given size m m . After partial results due to Friedland and Stanley, Rowlinson completely confirmed the conjecture.

arxiv-2506-22108.title: The relationship between episcopal genealogy and ideology in the Roman Catholic Church
arxiv-2506-22108.creator: Marta Baratto, Ivan Casanovas, Ivan Decostanzi, Henrique Machado Borges, Samuel Martínez Alcalá, Ilaria Stanzani, Alberto Antonioni, Iacopo Iacopini, Michele Re Fiorentin, Eugenio Valdano
arxiv-2506-22108.description: Abstract In this study we investigate how hierarchical structures within the Roman Catholic Church shape the ideological orientation of its leadership. The full episcopal genealogy dataset comprises over 35,000 bishops, each typically consecrated by one principal consecrator and two co-consecrators, forming a dense and historically continuous directed network of episcopal lineage.

arxiv-2509-16786.title: Line-width and path-width
arxiv-2509-16786.creator: Tung Nguyen, Alex Scott, Paul Seymour
arxiv-2509-16786.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Tung Nguyen, Alex Scott, Paul Seymour. For finite graphs, path-width is an interesting and useful concept, but if we extend it to infinite graphs in the most obvious way (by making the indexing path infinite), it does not work nicely. The simplest extension that works nicely is to allow the indexing set to be any totally-ordered set, and then the corresponding decomposition is called a “line-decomposition”, and the maximum bag size needed is called “line-width”.

arxiv-2510-10683.title: A topological counting rule for shells
arxiv-2510-10683.creator: Hussein Nassar
arxiv-2510-10683.description: Abstract Holding a shell in their hands, one can apply six loads: three by pulling and shearing, and three by bending and twisting. Here, it is shown that the shell will resist exactly three load cases and comply with the other three, provided the shell is simply connected, meaning it has no holes and no handles.

arxiv-2510-25953.title: A Natural Language Interface for Efficient Data Retrieval in SDSS
arxiv-2510-25953.creator: Prathamesh Tamhane
arxiv-2510-25953.description: Abstract Modern astronomical surveys such as the Sloan Digital Sky Survey (SDSS) provide extensive astronomical databases enabling researchers to access vast amount of diverse data. However, retrieving data from archives requires knowledge of query languages and familiarity with their schema, which presents a barrier for non-experts.

pmc-10505604.description: BackgroundCreeping fat is a pathological feature of small bowel Crohn’s disease (CD), with literature suggesting that bowel resection with extended mesenteric resection is related to less postoperative recurrences. Conventional imaging is unable to accurately quantify the disease involvement (i.e., fibrosis) of creeping fat. Quantification of disease involvement could be useful in decision-making for additional extended mesenteric resection.

pmc-10606411.creator: Zihao Fang, Dejun Chen, Yunxiu Zeng, Tao Wang, Kai Xu, Éloi Bossé
pmc-10606411.description: The problem of goal recognition involves inferring the high-level task goals of an agent based on observations of its behavior in an environment. Current methods for achieving this task rely on offline comparison inference of observed behavior in discrete environments, which presents several challenges. First, accurately modeling the behavior of the observed agent requires significant computational resources.

pmc-11597112.title: Highly Efficient Reduction of Cr (VI) with C4H6O6
pmc-11597112.creator: Hao Peng, Zonghui Qin, Guixuan Jin, Jingjing Wang, Jielin Qin, Lihua Ao, Bing Li
pmc-11597112.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). In this paper, tartaric acid (C4H6O6) was used as a reductant to treat chromium (VI)-containing solution. Several independent experimental parameters, including reaction temperature, concentration of H2SO4, concentration of C4H6O6 and reaction time, on the reduction process were studied. The results showed that 100% of the Cr (VI) could be reduced by C4H6O6 in a strong acidic environment under a high reaction temperature.

pmc-11690743.description: GSA is approaching its 80th anniversary, prompting us to reflect on the origins and rich history of gerontology. Gerontology’s roots trace back to the early 1900s, an era where older age was often perceived solely as a period of physical and mental decline. However, over time, our understanding of aging has significantly evolved.

pmc-12552127.description: Hepatic gluconeogenesis produces glucose from various substrates to meet energy demands. However, how these substrates are preferentially used under different conditions remains unclear. Here, we show that preferential supplies of lactate and glycerol modulate hepatic gluconeogenesis, thereby impacting high-intensity and low-intensity exercise capacities, respectively.

pmc-12604316.title: Regulatory effects of Sini-San on bile acid homeostasis in the enterohepatic circulation of mice with liver fibrosis
pmc-12604316.creator: Fangsi Zhu, Yijie Ding, Luyun Chen, Rou Fang, Chengfeng Huang, En Liu, Yingrui Wang, Yong Su, Chaoliang Ge
pmc-12604316.description: BackgroundSini-San (SNS), a classical traditional Chinese medicinal formula, has demonstrated promising potential in mitigating the progression of liver fibrosis (LF). Increasing evidence highlights that disruption of bile acids (BAs) homeostasis is critically involved in the pathogenesis and progression of LF, suggesting that targeting BAs metabolism could represent a therapeutic strategy.

pmc-13125061.title: Case Report: Lung transplant recipient with bullous pemphigoid and antibody-mediated rejection: an overlapping immunologic phenomenon?
pmc-13125061.creator: Sandrine Hanna, Daniel Gutteridge, Christiane Machado, Mrunal G. Patel, David W. Roe, Nichole A. Smith, Biplab Saha
pmc-13125061.description: We present what is, to our knowledge, the first reported case of concurrent bullous pemphigoid (BP) and antibody-mediated rejection (AMR) in a lung transplant patient. Similar associations have been described in other solid organ transplant settings, most notably in renal transplantation, where explantation of the allograft has frequently been followed by resolution of the skin disease.

pmc-13233247.title: Editorial: Natural compounds/products and livestock productivity: enhancing antioxidant levels, gut health, mitigating greenhouse gas emissions, and disease control, volume II

pmc-13377068.creator: Xinyu Liang, Kaixiang Zhuang, Yun Wang, Yueting Su, Jianfeng Feng, Feng Zhou, Benjamin Becker, Deniz Vatansever

Here, we introduce a data-driven framework to characterise the latent neural architecture of shared aesthetic evaluations.
